line_by_line: Each of the three mapped reads (entry, G record, event file) is wrapped in its own try/except ProducerRegistryUnavailable; the first exception is remembered (deferred = deferred or exc). Items 1-2.

An unavailable entry 'continue's (nothing about it can be known); an unavailable G record skips only that entry's G-operation check (else-branch); an unavailable event file skips only that event's CONSUME check. Every other read and check runs unchanged, in the same order, with the same messages. Items 3 and 6.
A positive IntegrityError is raised at once and re-raised unchanged by the outer handler (isinstance IntegrityError and not DurableUnavailable). Item 4.
After a complete scan the first deferred ProducerRegistryUnavailable object is raised. Item 5.
No new read site; _producer_registry_read, ProducerRegistryUnavailable and every other method are unchanged.

detail: The current-G durable entry is compared with the boundary-bound producer bytes before and independently of the scan (elif registry != producers[0]) - lead D8-01 scope limit; scope 04 F1_ordering item 1.

The scan, its deferral of (OSError, ProducerRegistryUnavailable) and the marker comparison keep their sealed positions; the residual check 'registered is None or _raw(registered) != producers[0]' can now differ only by a read race, because strict_private_json requires canonical bytes.

When this G's entry is unavailable and no mismatch is known after the marker comparison, the unchanged scan runs ignoring only (OSError, ProducerRegistryUnavailable) (DV8-5); positive mismatches raise; an unmapped Unavailable propagates as Unavailable.

produce_private_verification: Refused or phase != 'verification' -> REFUSED_PRECONDITION; verification-phase Unavailable -> UNAVAILABLE; other verification IntegrityError -> FAILED_VERIFICATION; write/recorded phases re-raise without outcome; the exception object propagated is unchanged.

DV8-1 checked by attributing each injected fault to the phase that first touched it: 8 protected-entry and 4 _preconditions faults gave REFUSED_PRECONDITION with the typed DurableUnavailable propagated and the verifier not entered (Seal 07: UNAVAILABLE); 7 verification-phase faults gave UNAVAILABLE in both seals; write-phase and post-PASS faults wrote no new outcome; every REFUSED_PRECONDITION was non-terminal (PASS after exact restoration). The retained generation-boundary record is first read at protected entry, so its unavailability is REFUSED_PRECONDITION under the phase rule.

d_derived_readings.DV8-2: CONFIRMED BY LEAD; S7-IQ-F3 behavior identical to Seal 07 in every probed state (see S8-IQ-F1).
d_derived_readings.DV8-3: CONFIRMED BY LEAD; holds on the sealed bytes: within the scan every faulted state opens a subset of the healthy scan's files and stats nothing beyond them except the faulted object itself (probe I01); a healthy produce() opens the identical 1678-file normalized sequence in Seal 07 and Seal 08; in faulted states the extra Seal-08 reads are only the healthy traversal's own registry entries, G records, event files and catalogue (probe I02).

DV8-4.basis: It is the only reading that satisfies together D8-01 item 4 (positive evidence wins), Disposition 05 item 7 and DV8-2 (an unmapped error is neither deferred nor converted) and single-condition preservation: after a deferral, a non-positive error ends the scan with exactly the Seal-07 result, so the marker comparison still runs (E-marker-sub+first-dir+catalogue-scan stays FAILED_VERIFICATION; propagating the unmapped error instead would turn it into UNAVAILABLE). Its residual - a positive mismatch sorted after the non-positive error is not reached (F04a) - is no larger than the masking the non-positive error causes alone (F05) and is the record-only S7-IQ-F3 class. Cosmetic: the re-raised deferred object keeps its message but its __context__ becomes the later error.

DV8-5.assessment: SOUND PLACEMENT of the lead-approved option C bullet ('_operational_boundary also runs the scan when the current G's own entry is unavailable'); recommended for confirmation with S8-IQ-F2 noted
DV8-5.basis: Running the scan after the marker comparison keeps 'own entry unavailable + marker mismatch' FAILED_VERIFICATION even when the scan meets an unmapped Unavailable (E-marker-sub+own-dir+catalogue-scan); it consults only the healthy traversal's objects (I02) and manufactures no evidence (C06, C07, C09 stay UNAVAILABLE then PASS). Side effect recorded in S8-IQ-F2: a non-IntegrityError from a malformed entry now propagates in this state where Seal 07 recorded UNAVAILABLE.
